decks.create: INSERT INTO decks (id, name, active_version, group_id, sort_order, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, NULL, ?, ?, ?, ?)
decks.get_by_id: SELECT d.id, d.name, d.active_version, d.group_id, d.sort_order, d.created_at, d.updated_at, d.favorite, d.last_viewed_at, v.status AS active_status, v.has_thumb AS active_has_thumb, (SELECT MAX(version_no) FROM deck_versions WHERE deck_id = d.id) AS latest_version FROM decks d LEFT JOIN deck_versions v ON v.deck_id = d.id AND v.version_no = d.active_version WHERE d.id = ?
decks.get_organization: SELECT id, group_id, sort_order FROM decks WHERE id = ?
decks.list_ready_latest: SELECT d.id, d.name, d.active_version, d.group_id, d.sort_order, d.created_at, d.updated_at, d.favorite, d.last_viewed_at, v.status AS active_status, v.has_thumb AS active_has_thumb, (SELECT MAX(version_no) FROM deck_versions WHERE deck_id = d.id) AS latest_version FROM decks d JOIN deck_versions v ON v.deck_id = d.id AND v.version_no = d.active_version WHERE v.status = 'ready' ORDER BY d.created_at DESC, d.id DESC
decks.set_active: UPDATE decks SET active_version = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?
decks.update_name: UPDATE decks SET name = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?
decks.update_order: UPDATE decks SET sort_order = ? WHERE id = ?
decks.set_membership: UPDATE decks SET group_id = ?, sort_order = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?
decks.set_favorite: UPDATE decks SET favorite = ? WHERE id = ?
decks.record_visit: UPDATE decks SET last_viewed_at = ? WHERE id = ?

deck_groups.create: INSERT INTO deck_groups (id, name, parent_id, sort_order, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
deck_groups.get: SELECT id, name, parent_id, sort_order, created_at, updated_at FROM deck_groups WHERE id = ?
deck_groups.list_ordered: SELECT id, name, parent_id, sort_order, created_at, updated_at FROM deck_groups ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
deck_groups.list_siblings: SELECT id FROM deck_groups WHERE parent_id IS ? ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
deck_groups.find_name_conflict: SELECT id FROM deck_groups WHERE parent_id IS ? AND name = ? AND (? IS NULL OR id <> ?) LIMIT 1
deck_groups.update_name: UPDATE deck_groups SET name = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?
deck_groups.update_order: UPDATE deck_groups SET sort_order = ? WHERE id = ?
deck_groups.set_parent: UPDATE deck_groups SET parent_id = ?, sort_order = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?

organization.list_deck_siblings: SELECT id, sort_order FROM decks WHERE group_id IS ? ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC

library.list_ready_decks: SELECT d.id, d.name, d.active_version, d.group_id, d.sort_order, d.created_at, d.updated_at, d.favorite, d.last_viewed_at, v.status AS active_status, v.has_thumb AS active_has_thumb, v.screens_json AS active_screens_json, (SELECT MAX(version_no) FROM deck_versions WHERE deck_id = d.id) AS latest_version, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM deck_versions WHERE deck_id = d.id) AS total_versions, (SELECT created_at FROM deck_versions WHERE deck_id = d.id ORDER BY version_no DESC LIMIT 1) AS latest_version_at FROM decks d JOIN deck_versions v ON v.deck_id = d.id AND v.version_no = d.active_version WHERE v.status = 'ready' ORDER BY d.sort_order ASC, d.id ASC
library.get_ready_deck: SELECT d.id, d.name, d.active_version, d.group_id, d.sort_order, d.created_at, d.updated_at, d.favorite, d.last_viewed_at, v.status AS active_status, v.has_thumb AS active_has_thumb, v.screens_json AS active_screens_json, (SELECT MAX(version_no) FROM deck_versions WHERE deck_id = d.id) AS latest_version, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM deck_versions WHERE deck_id = d.id) AS total_versions, (SELECT created_at FROM deck_versions WHERE deck_id = d.id ORDER BY version_no DESC LIMIT 1) AS latest_version_at FROM decks d JOIN deck_versions v ON v.deck_id = d.id AND v.version_no = d.active_version WHERE d.id = ? AND v.status = 'ready'

deck_versions.create: INSERT INTO deck_versions (deck_id, version_no, status, has_thumb, idempotency_key, error_message, created_at, updated_at, note) VALUES (?, ?, 'processing', 0, ?, NULL, ?, ?, ?)
deck_versions.get: SELECT * FROM deck_versions WHERE deck_id = ? AND version_no = ?
deck_versions.list_by_deck: SELECT * FROM deck_versions WHERE deck_id = ? ORDER BY version_no ASC
deck_versions.max_version: SELECT MAX(version_no) AS n FROM deck_versions WHERE deck_id = ?
deck_versions.update_status: UPDATE deck_versions SET status = ?, error_message = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE deck_id = ? AND version_no = ?
deck_versions.update_thumb: UPDATE deck_versions SET has_thumb = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE deck_id = ? AND version_no = ?
deck_versions.update_screens: UPDATE deck_versions SET screens_json = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE deck_id = ? AND version_no = ?
deck_versions.delete_one: DELETE FROM deck_versions WHERE deck_id = ? AND version_no = ?
deck_versions.update_note: UPDATE deck_versions SET note = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE deck_id = ? AND version_no = ?
